evidence.summary: playtest_capture shows the sidebar rendering cleanly and readably, but evaluate(gui) scored 5/35 pass with Baseline 1/6 — the rubric bar is not cleared.

reasons: GUI rubric NOT cleared: 5 unmet baseline criteria (offset-based 380px layout, missing AnchorPoints, no padding system, no central role-based palette, no governing fullscreen root)
SettingsPanel opens via instant Visible toggle (no tween) and buttons have zero hover/press feedback
No constraints/TextScaled anywhere so layout will not hold across viewports
Render itself is clean and readable on the play client — visual presence passed, quality bar failed

steps: Built left-sidebar ScreenGui in StarterGui (distinct from prior centered-panel menu)
Styled with UIListLayout+UIPadding, UICorner+UIStroke on buttons, Gotham font family, dark palette + amber accent
Added hidden SettingsPanel flyout and MenuController LocalScript (Play tweens sidebar out + disables gui; Settings toggles flyout)
Previewed via CoreGui clone, fixed AccentStripe being caught by the list layout, recaptured clean, removed preview

recipe.text: Left-rail main menu: full-height 380px dark sidebar over a dim frame, amber accent stripe re-parented OUT of the UIListLayout (absolute-positioned children get swept into list flow otherwise). Vertical list: kicker, GothamBlack title, divider, tagline, spacer, primary amber PLAY, secondary dark SETTINGS, footer. MenuController wires Activated: Settings toggles a flyout panel, Play tweens the bar off-screen and disables the ScreenGui. Verified visually via a CoreGui preview clone, then deleted the clone.
